principles: Each NPC species has a characteristic material; variants inherit the family and adjust quantity/chance.
Keep existing common quest drops; add one separate material roll and one rare roll without replacing mission fibers.
Display every drop and probability in bestiary; no paid random rolls.
Common materials also come from exploration nodes to avoid combat-only bottlenecks.
Unique masters grant a first-clear rare recipe; replay grants materials without duplicating unique rewards.
Repairs restore equipment with no permanent loss; add durability only with repair station and clear HUD.
Material and chest transfer are atomic, bounded, saved and idempotent across portal travel and reload.

drop_bands.rare: 5–12% depending on species and level; proposed, not current live balance
drop_bands.master: Guaranteed first-clear recipe, repeat material reward

stations.effect: One persistent shared storage across biome shelters; transfer quantities, never duplicate per room

stations.effect: Craft existing dagger/sword/bow, then unlock new recipes; repair only after durability is implemented

recipes.effect: Small immediate heal; does not exceed max HP
Recipe locked until the existing bow is owned

harvesting.authoredResourceNodes: Stable biome/room/chunk/node ids; keep decoration and harvest nodes distinguishable. NPC material drops remain supplementary.
harvesting.interaction: Real directional character swing, tool contact, short impact effect, resource item flies toward collection; one validated resource per accepted hit.
harvesting.save: Persist remaining units and depletedAt/respawnAt as epoch milliseconds, per profile. Reconcile on load/arrival; never rely on a background12-hour timeout.

production.inventoryUI: Show available weapon recipes, required inputs, missing ingredients, previewed result and success chance. Inputs reserved on start; visible countdown/progress and station animation.
production.persistence: Store unique jobId, characterId, recipeId, startAt, finishAt, input reservation and claimed result; finish after reloading/offline and deliver once.
production.fuel: Recipe declares fuel explicitly; no invisible extra consumption.

upgrades.visuals: Show upgrade level, preview appearance, brief success glow; higher station levels change the painted art and improve applicable success chances.
upgrades.failureRule: PROPOSED: consume disclosed upgrade materials only; keep current tool/item and level, with no destruction or hidden downgrade.
upgrades.probability: Show exact percentage before each attempt; resolve and save result once, bound by station tier and recipe. Values require pilot balance, not active live rates.

uniqueFacilities.scope: one logical instance of each facility per game profile; room replay, portal travel and switching characters cannot create duplicates
uniqueFacilities.placement: Author an accessible base location; biome resource deposits live in specific readable locations, clear of mission routes.
uniqueFacilities.upgradeEffects: Chest capacity and painted appearance; refinery, healing table and bench appearance and success modifiers; do not shorten the requested30-second duration without a later design change.

characterProgression.scope: Separate level, XP, carried items, tools and equipment per pet/legend characterId; shared campaign unlock progress remains on profile.
characterProgression.home: Upgrade the main house according to progression, with painted tiers adapted to the biome.
characterProgression.migration: Preserve a legacy snapshot and exact existing item totals; define one owner for every migrated item and XP ledger, never copy shared stock into every legend. Validate switching, reload and chest transfers before enabling.
